subject: Melanie Tringali City Council Candidacy
overview: Candidate Melanie Tringali presented her platform for the Medford City Council, emphasizing neighborhood preservation, infrastructure maintenance, and fiscal transparency.

items.title: Candidate Background and Motivation
items.summary: Melanie Tringali introduced herself as a lifelong Medford resident with 20 years of business experience and extensive local volunteer history, running to shift the council's focus from ideology to local challenges.

items.title: Zoning and Infrastructure Priorities
items.summary: Tringali pledged to protect neighborhoods from blanket rezoning for high-density housing and prioritize the repair of crumbling streets and sidewalks for seniors and the physically challenged.

items.title: Public Safety and Fiscal Accountability
items.summary: The candidate advocated for full staffing and modern equipment for emergency personnel while calling for line-item budgets and transparent reporting of the city's cash reserves.

items.title: Traffic Planning and Conclusion
items.summary: Tringali called for data-driven traffic planning over lane reductions and concluded by requesting one of seven votes in the upcoming election to serve as an independent voice for Medford.
